name: Tailscale
description: Tailscale mesh-VPN integration. Adds /api/tailscale/{status,login,logout} endpoints (settings UI uses these to drive the SSO login flow) and the ref-tailscale reference node so the agent has authoritative docs about the Tailscale CLI. Requires the tailscaled daemon to be running inside the container — that's a system-level concern handled by entrypoint.sh / Dockerfile (gated by SPORE_TAILSCALE_ENABLED=true), not the plugin. Compute-cluster routing (SSH over tailscale MagicDNS) stays in core.
